_doc: Evidence fields each GoalLore Lab mechanism class needs before the planner may draw it. A field is filled only by a verbatim source quote that contains its value (topic.mechanism.<field> = { value, fact }); the planner checks that the cited fact's quote contains the value and refuses otherwise. Nothing here is a value: it is the list of what research must capture.

fields.distance: distance to goal (m or yd), quoted
fields.keeperAction: what the keeper did (did not move / dived left/right), quoted (optional: drawn as REPRESENTATIVE ready stance)
keeper's dive and its side (his left/right) or 'did not move', quoted
fields.placement: where the ball went (middle, corner, over the bar), quoted
fields.foot: kicking foot, quoted (optional: drawn as REPRESENTATIVE)

fields.delivery: how the ball arrived (corner, cross, free kick) and from which side, quoted
fields.distance: distance from goal when headed, quoted
fields.placement: where the header went (side of goal, past which defender/keeper), quoted

fields.shotType: the attempt saved (header, shot) and its direction (down, high, left/right), quoted
fields.contact: how the ball was saved (hand, tipped over the bar), quoted

fields.path: the run's start and finish on the pitch (halfway line, which flank), quoted or from licensed event data
fields.beaten: the players beaten, in order (names or count), quoted
fields.finish: how the goal was finished (round the keeper, shot side), quoted

fields.passes: the pass sequence (who to whom, roughly where), from licensed event data or quoted match reports
fields.finish: the final pass and finish (side, foot), quoted
